title: Seagrove "Crabb Shack" 162 Chivas Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Outdoor bar & kitchen opens May 18, 2026*Regulation striped pickleball court (nets and paddles coming May 2026)- Private pool with sun shelf *Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $45 per day- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 5 adult bikes- Gulf views- Private boardwalk to the beach (for beach access only, no set-up allowed)- Close proximity to the public beach- Large porches with outdoor living space- Stand-alone ice maker- EV charger- Unlimited parking - 150' driveway and back parking motor court paved and completed - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: This 4 bedroom home is exactly what you and your family have been looking for! With a private pool and close beach access, you will feel relaxed at your own oasis. With a reverse open floor plan, enjoy a gorgeous gourmet kitchen, breakfast nook, and living room, all with beautiful Seagrove views. Just off this area, the porch features a great outdoor dining and living area. This level also includes a primary bedroom with a connected porch and ensuite bath. The third floor boasts 2 beautiful guest bedrooms, a king and queen bed, and private bathroom. Just down the hall, you will find a Bunk room with 2 sets of bunk beds, extra living space, and a loft area equipped with a Queen Sleeper Sofa, perfect for kids and guests. Downstairs, you will find a perfect guest bedroom with a Queen Murphy bed and private bathroom. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Murphy Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Half bathroomTHIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds- Loft Area: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Small pool house project and sport court addition occurring in surrounding area.
